doc.title: Fred Lipsius interviewed by Monk Rowe. Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018

title: Spiritual path and view of masters
summary: He calls his spiritual path his first love, speaks of spiritual masters, the Eck, and compassion.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: Well thanks for sharing that with me. You’ve made an impression on a lot of people.
And you seem to be a spiritual man, from what I’ve seen from your website.
That’s my first take on life. That’s my first love of life. More than music. I was thinking, if you asked me. I love my wife, she’s my sweetheart, but my spiritual path has been half

my life and I’ve had a lot of spiritual experience. I’m not bragging. I tell people that look up to me, I say, “Look, there’s little kids born today that are more mature spiritually than me, but I’ve been with spiritual masters that are hundreds and thousands of years old that have been teaching for millions of years.” And I’m learning how to become a master. It’s not to have any control over anybody. These masters are teaching each soul that’s ready and willing, how to experience of God, which is the purpose that we’re all here. Most people don’t know. That’s without bragging about it.
When you look at the current events does, how do you justify those things for yourself?

I’m not, when I say I’m not interested, the deeper you get to love yourself as a spiritual being, a soul, an atom of God, and you start to love people more, I have a deeper feeling for life. I can’t explain it. I’m going to cry now, and the master I study with, I’m very sensitive. He says, “I hate to tell you but the higher you go spiritually and become a master someday or in another lifetime, you become more compassionate.” I said, “More?” Well, you know, you feel, these masters know the thought of every soul in every universe of God. They know every life you’ve ever lived, and it’s not power, they just have become more with the voice of God, which is the Holy Spirit in Christianity. We call it the Eck. It’s God’s love. That’s all it is. It’s light and sound. Interesting, because God’s love is actually really light and sound, sound being the highest aspect. So being a musician, you know I hear Coltrane and Bird and all these people. Spiritually to take drugs, that’s not the thing. The masters don’t advocate drugs at all. I don’t need drugs. You can quietly sing a spiritual word. Like “Hu.” It’s an ancient name for God. And you might elevate yourself into an expanded state of consciousness where you might be on another level way beyond these planets.
